description: Quote a swap of BTC through Satora: Lightning or Arkade into USDC or USDT0 on Arbitrum, or Lightning ↔ Arkade. Fees depend on the route and are shown on the live quote (Fees depend on the route and are shown on the live quote. Lightning or Arkade to USDC or USDT0 (and back) is about 1% total (Satora ~0.5% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee. Lightning to Arkade is about 0.65% total (Satora ~0.15% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee. Arkade to Lightning is about 0.80% total (Satora ~0.30% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee). Nothing is created

address.description: payout destination: 0x on Arbitrum (to a stablecoin) or an Ark address on https://arkade.computer (to arkade)

from.description: where the BTC comes from (default lightning)

invoice.description: from arkade to lightning: a BOLT11 invoice with an amount

sats.description: sats to send (required for BTC → stablecoin and Lightning → Arkade; omit when an invoice pins an Arkade → Lightning payout)

to.description: stablecoin on Arbitrum (default usdc), or lightning/arkade for a Lightning ↔ Arkade swap

name: swap_quote
